_comment: Folio legal docs manifest. Source of truth for the latest ToS / Privacy version: a GitHub Action syncs this into Supabase tos_versions (which the app reads), and it is also bundled into the app as an offline fallback. Bump version + summary when ToS / Privacy changes.

terms.summary_zh: Folio 新增了「大家的便利貼」：每一本書都有一面公開的便利貼牆與書評區。當您在書櫃或共讀室的便利貼勾選「也貼到大家的便利貼」、在大家的便利貼按下「貼上牆」，或儲存書評時，那一則就會公開給同一個社群分區的所有人閱讀；預設署名您的暱稱，貼上牆與書評在 App 允許時也可以選擇匿名。書評一律公開，並會連同您給的評分一起顯示。因此本次補上公開發布的相關條款：您必須確保公開的內容是您本人所寫、沒有侵害他人的著作權或隱私；您隨時可以收回已公開的內容，收回後別人就看不到了，但已經被別人讀過、截圖或抄錄的部分，我們無法回收；在書櫃刪便利貼時選「只刪這裡」或移除整本書，不會刪掉已公開的那一份；刪除帳號時，您公開的便利貼與書評會一併刪除，不會像共讀室的內容那樣匿名保留。若內容經檢舉審查認定違規，我們會將它下架（對應的私人便利貼之後不能再用來公開），並可能暫時停止您在公開牆發布的權限；下架不會影響您自己書櫃裡的私人副本。便利貼牆依閱讀進度分成六段，那是為了避免劇透而設計的，並不是隱私或權限設定。另外，我們依 App 實際運作更正了幾處說明：停權通知一律在 App 內告知，不寄 Email；冷卻期自註冊時起算；停權雜湊只在永久停權時記錄；長期未使用帳號的刪除條件是連續 24 個月未登入且未使用（訂閱中的帳號除外）；訂閱結束後，已套用的書背樣式保留但不能再修改；可以分享出去的是讀後心得分享卡。
terms.summary_en: Folio now includes "Everyone's sticky notes": every book has a public sticky-note wall and a review section. When you tick "Also post to Everyone's sticky notes" on a shelf or co-reading room note, tap "Stick it on the wall" in Everyone's sticky notes, or save a review, that content becomes public to everyone in your community partition; it is attributed to your nickname by default, and notes stuck on the wall and reviews can also be posted anonymously where the app allows. Reviews are always public and are shown with the rating you gave. These Terms therefore now cover public publishing: you must ensure what you publish is written by you and does not infringe anyone's copyright or privacy; you may take published content back at any time and others can then no longer see it, but we cannot recall what others have already read, screenshotted, or copied down; choosing "Delete here only" when deleting a note on your shelf, or removing the whole book, does not delete the published copy; when you delete your account, the notes and reviews you published are deleted too, rather than kept anonymously like co-reading room content. If content is found to breach these Terms following a report review, we will take it down (the corresponding private note can no longer be used to publish it again) and may temporarily suspend your ability to publish to the public wall; a takedown does not affect the private copy on your own shelf. The wall's six reading bands exist to prevent spoilers and are not a privacy or permission setting. We have also corrected several descriptions to match how the app actually works: suspension notices are given in the app only, never by email; cooldowns start at registration; the suspension-evasion hash is recorded only for permanent suspensions; an unused account is deleted after 24 consecutive months with no sign-in and no use (except accounts with an active subscription); once a subscription ends, book-spine styles you applied are kept but can no longer be edited; and what you can share outside the app is the reflection share card.

privacy.summary_zh: 本次更新揭露 App 1.0.17 新增的兩項資料處理。一、國際區新增「匯入書單」：您以作業系統的檔案選取器挑選 Goodreads 或 StoryGraph 的匯出檔（CSV），檔案完全在您的裝置上解析，只有三項資料會存進 Folio 的伺服器：書名、匯出檔裡記載的作者文字，以及那一列是不是被標記為已讀（標記為已讀的存成閱讀進度 100%，其餘存成 0%，而且不會覆蓋您原本已有的進度）。如果那一列有 ISBN，Folio 也會把 ISBN 送到自己的伺服器，只用來在站方書目裡找出對應的作品，比對完就丟掉、不會儲存。匯出檔裡的評分、閱讀日期、已讀與否以外的書架名稱、書評文字，以及檔案本身，都不會上傳、Folio 也不會儲存；匯入結束後，Folio 不會在您的裝置上保留這個檔案或它的解析結果，檔案仍留在您的作業系統原本存放的地方。匯入不會連線到 Goodreads 或 StoryGraph，也不會把您的書單交給任何第三方；上傳的書名只在 Folio 自己的伺服器上與站方書目比對，和您手動加入一本書時相同。匯入的書就是您書房裡的書，顯示、保留與刪除規則與您手動加入的書完全一樣。二、封面圖片與書目資料來源：書籍封面一直是由您的裝置直接向 Google Books、Open Library 與國家圖書館載入，本次寫明這適用於 App 內所有顯示封面的畫面；國際區版面在貼文、書櫃與共讀室列表等更多畫面顯示封面，您的裝置向這些服務載入圖片的次數也隨之增加。另外，Folio 的伺服器每天一次向 Open Library 取得公開的每週熱門書單，供國際區用戶瀏覽，Folio 的英文書目資料也取自 Open Library 的公開資料集；這兩件事都由 Folio 的伺服器發出，不含您的帳號識別碼、IP 位址、書櫃內容或任何其他個人資料，Open Library 在此是資料來源，不是您個人資料的接收者。最後補充說明一項既有機制：站方的書目資料（書名、作者等由 Folio 整理的書目欄位，不是用戶內容）不受社群分區限制，您搜尋書籍或輸入書名時，可能看到另一個分區目錄裡的書（清單中會標示為其他語言）；但用戶內容，也就是貼文、公開便利貼、書評與書友頁，仍然只在同一個社群分區內顯示。本次《服務條款》未變更，維持 1.8 版。
privacy.summary_en: This update discloses two new kinds of processing in app 1.0.17. First, the international community gains "Import your library": you pick a Goodreads or StoryGraph export file (CSV) with your operating system's file picker, the file is parsed entirely on your device, and only three things are stored on Folio's servers: the book title, the author text as written in the export, and whether that row was marked as read (rows marked as read are stored as 100% reading progress and all other rows as 0%, and they never overwrite progress you already have). If a row carries an ISBN, Folio also sends it to its own server solely to find the matching work in its catalogue; it is discarded after the lookup and never stored. Star ratings, dates read, shelf names other than read or not-read, review text, and the file itself are never uploaded and never stored by Folio; once the import finishes, Folio keeps neither the file nor anything parsed from it on your device, and the file stays wherever your operating system keeps it. The import does not connect to Goodreads or StoryGraph and hands your library to no third party; the uploaded titles are matched against Folio's own book catalogue on Folio's own servers, exactly as when you add a book by hand. Imported books are simply books on your shelf, with the same visibility, retention, and deletion rules as books you add by hand. Second, cover images and catalogue data sources: book covers have always been loaded by your device directly from Google Books, Open Library, and the National Central Library (Taiwan), and we now state that this applies to every screen in the app that shows a cover; the international layout shows covers on more screens, such as post cards, the shelf, and the co-reading room list, so your device loads images from those services more often. In addition, once a day Folio's server fetches the public weekly trending list from Open Library for users in the international community, and Folio's English book catalogue was imported from Open Library's public dataset; both requests are made by Folio's server and contain no account identifier, no IP address of yours, nothing from your shelf, and no other personal data, so Open Library is a data source for us here, not a recipient of your personal data. Finally, we clarify one existing behaviour: Folio's book catalogue (bibliographic fields such as title and author compiled by Folio, not user content) is not limited by community, so when you search for a book or type a title you may see books from the other community's catalogue (marked in the list as another language); user content, meaning posts, public notes, reviews, and reader pages, still appears only within a single community. The Terms of Service are unchanged and remain at version 1.8.
